goal: When a disk/inode preflight finds free space or inodes below the configured threshold, the worker records a queryable degraded-space state and skips the authoritative store write for that unit instead of letting that write hard-crash on ENOSPC; above threshold it proceeds normally and the store write is reached.

graders.run: uv run pytest -k "module_purity or sdk_optional or import_without"
graders.name: purity-holdout

relevant: packages/flywheel-worktree/src/flywheel_worktree/worker.py -- the worker run path that drives a unit into the authoritative store write; add a guarded low-space preflight (a free-space/inode probe via shutil.disk_usage / os.statvfs) ahead of that write.

packages/flywheel-core/src/flywheel_core/harness.py -- around line 814 telemetry writes are already crash-swallowed; the AUTHORITATIVE store write is what hard-fails on ENOSPC. The preflight surfaces a degraded record BEFORE that write rather than catching the crash after.

packages/flywheel-core/src/flywheel_core/store_protocols.py -- the degraded-space record should surface on the worker's status/telemetry surface so it is queryable; do not put the disk-probe logic in flywheel_core.task/lifecycle.
constraints: Below threshold: produce a QUERYABLE degraded-space record (readable via the worker's status/telemetry surface) AND do NOT invoke the authoritative store write for that unit (the write that would crash on ENOSPC).
Above threshold: normal flow proceeds and the store write IS reached -- the preflight must not block healthy operation.
The probe/preflight logic lives in the worker layer (NOT flywheel_core.task/lifecycle -- purity); the threshold is configurable and default-on; magnitude is not load-bearing.
Commit the change with a clear message before reporting done.
non_goals: Do not catch the store-write OSError after the fact -- the preflight declines BEFORE the crashing write (state must not be half-written).
Do not recover or re-drive the declined unit (later phases own that); stop at 'degraded record exists and crashing write was skipped'.
Do not place disk/json/io logic in flywheel_core.task or flywheel_core.lifecycle (the purity-holdout grader pins this).
Do not modify or weaken existing purity/store tests; do not weaken assertions.
edge_cases: Below threshold but a printed success string -- must fail: the grader reads the classified degraded record and the not-called store write, not stdout.
Above threshold -- the store write must be reached (no false degrade).
Inode exhaustion with bytes free (and vice versa) -- either below-threshold dimension triggers the degraded path.
